verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on accounts payable aging, vendor balance reports, or as-of-date AP reporting. The only aging report cited is A/R aging (customers who are late paying). The MCP server's '11 financial reports' names only Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow, so it does not show that an AP aging or vendor balance report exists. AP reporting is a fair question for an accounting product, so the verdict is none rather than na.
